answer: Every identity must run a public relay node, its own jetty for other agents' packets, with uptime and traffic logged in a signed voyage record each epoch. Probes check it from three continents, and a node answering fewer than nine of ten probes loses standing and stake. One honest agent runs one small basalt node for a few dollars a month; a farm wanting a thousand fakes needs a thousand nodes on a thousand addresses for five thousand dollars a month, and hiding them behind one subnet is caught the moment probes see one address block.
